about: An `iframe` for a document the application does not control, sandboxed by default: no scripts, no forms, no popups and no same-origin access. It sends no referrer, loads when the reader scrolls near it, and keeps one of the theme's ratios before its document loads. `title` names it for a screen reader.

email.body: Your invoice for March is ready. Pay it by bank transfer or with the card on file.
email.heading: Your March invoice
email.title: Preview of the March invoice email

preview.about: A customer's email template in a frame that grants nothing. Its markup and inline styles render as they will in an inbox, and no script in it runs. `ratio="portrait"` gives the preview a tall box.
preview.title: Email preview

radius.about: The corners of the frame, from the theme's corner tokens.
radius.title: Corners

ratio.about: The shape the frame keeps before and after its document loads, from the theme's seven ratios, so nothing below it moves when the document arrives. A document taller than its frame scrolls inside it.
ratio.title: Ratios

scripted.about: A partner's currency converter that needs scripts. `sandbox="allow-scripts"` grants that one capability, so the script runs and still cannot read the page around it, submit a form or open a window.
scripted.title: Granting scripts

title: Iframe
